observations: Photo 0 shows a large, dirty engine with various hoses, wires, and components attached. The engine block is metallic and shows signs of wear and grime. A black box with a label is visible on the front, but the text is not legible.

Photo 1 shows the same engine from a different angle, with a person in an orange shirt partially visible. The engine appears to be a complete unit, including the front and rear sections. The engine is dirty and has visible rust and grime. The black box with a label is again visible, but the text is not readable.

The engine has a complex array of components: intake manifold, throttle body, sensors, and wiring harnesses. The rear section shows what appears to be a transmission or gearbox housing, but it is not clearly identifiable as a gearbox.
The engine is outdoors on a dirt ground, surrounded by debris and construction materials. There is no visible branding or model number on the engine block or components in either photo.
The seller claims it is an LS460 engine and gearbox for Lexus cars, but no visual evidence confirms this.

claims.claim: LS460 Engine and Gear Box for Lexus Cars
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model number on the engine or gearbox in either photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine and gearbox may not be from a Lexus LS460 as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or gearbox housing showing the Lexus logo or model number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used engine and gearbox, not as a Lexus LS460, which would reduce value.

risks.risk: The engine may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running or a close-up of the internal components (e.g., cylinder head, crankshaft) to verify condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be damaged or incompatible with the engine.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the gearbox housing showing the model number and condition, and a photo of the engine's output shaft to confirm compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-functional or incompatible unit, reducing value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the engine block or gearbox housing showing the Lexus logo or model number.
Video or photo of the engine running or a close-up of internal components.
Close-up photo of the gearbox housing showing model number and condition.
Photo of the engine's output shaft to confirm compatibility.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
